# B-Tree Page Compatibility Fixtures

These databases were generated by the pinned SQLite command-line shell:

```text
3.54.0 2026-10-02 20:18:07 65ec11f05a9ee5b23495427ece76c0550a8ffc28980a8a0c72d556ba0d2290e2
```

Both use 512-byte pages, DELETE journal mode, application ID `1297305932`,
and user version `16`. Both passed the pinned shell's
`PRAGMA integrity_check`.

## `sqlite-3.54.0-btree-pages.db`

This 59-page auto-vacuum database contains:

- page 1: `sqlite_schema` table leaf;
- page 2: pointer map;
- page 3: `sample` table interior;
- page 4: `sample_name` index interior;
- page 5: `sample` table leaf;
- page 7: `sample_name` index leaf;
- pages 54 through 58: one overflow chain; and
- page 59: the table leaf cell whose 3017-byte record starts that chain.

Representative pointer-map entries on page 2 are:

| Target page | Type | Parent |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 3 | root page (1) | 0 |
| 5 | B-tree child (5) | 3 |
| 54 | first overflow (3) | 59 |
| 55 | later overflow (4) | 54 |

Generation SQL:

```sql
PRAGMA page_size=512;
PRAGMA auto_vacuum=FULL;
VACUUM;
PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE;
PRAGMA application_id=1297305932;
PRAGMA user_version=16;
CREATE TABLE sample(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload BLOB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX sample_name ON sample(name);
WITH RECURSIVE sequence(value) AS (
  VALUES(1)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT value + 1 FROM sequence WHERE value < 500
)
INSERT INTO sample(id, name, payload)
SELECT value,
       printf('name-%04d', value),
       CAST(printf('payload-%04d', value) AS BLOB)
FROM sequence;
INSERT INTO sample(id, name, payload)
VALUES(1001, 'overflow-row', zeroblob(3000));
```

SHA-256:

```text
de2c344ce0d044be98a925264b1de68178f0394460332c8a5b398ff4c65f66bf
```

## `sqlite-3.54.0-freelist.db`

This 329-page non-auto-vacuum database contains 327 freelist pages after
dropping a 320-row table. The freelist trunk chain is:

| Trunk page | Next trunk | Leaf count |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 213 | 126 | 84 |
| 126 | 4 | 120 |
| 4 | 0 | 120 |

Generation SQL:

```sql
PRAGMA page_size=512;
PRAGMA auto_vacuum=NONE;
VACUUM;
PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE;
PRAGMA application_id=1297305932;
PRAGMA user_version=16;
CREATE TABLE keep(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO keep VALUES(1, 'kept');
CREATE TABLE trash(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload BLOB NOT NULL);
WITH RECURSIVE sequence(value) AS (
  VALUES(1)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT value + 1 FROM sequence WHERE value < 320
)
INSERT INTO trash(id, payload)
SELECT value, zeroblob(400)
FROM sequence;
DROP TABLE trash;
```

SHA-256:

```text
5c8d298e4ff24f7d1afd6873c63c0788f99dd48940c60dc4947fb354311ec700
```
